en.title: Canadian Senior Denied Accessible Bus After 28 Years Sparks Nationwide Outcry
en.summary: A Canadian senior who used an accessible bus for 28 years was refused service after the transit authority claimed his wheelchair exceeded safety limits. The incident has drawn attention to accessibility enforcement and potential discrimination. Other developments include new marine accessibility programs in Taiwan, theatre renovations, and ongoing digital accessibility challenges.

zh-TW.title: 加拿大長者無障礙巴士遭拒載
zh-TW.summary: 一位在加拿大使用無障礙巴士28年的殘疾長者近日被拒絕上車，交通局稱其輪椅超過安全承載限制。此事件引發對無障礙交通執行的討論。同時，台灣海洋委員會推出16項親海無障礙活動，劇場翻修改善輪椅通行，線上購物仍存無障礙問題。
